lcc_original: 永恆主對挪亞說：『你和你全家都要進樓船，因爲在這世代我看只有你在我面前是個義人。
notes: 永恆主 is LCC's rendering of יהוה (UNV: 耶和華); SN03068 attached to the full phrase as a single lexical unit
UNV 進入 (two words) → LCC 進 (one word): merged <WH0935><WTH8798> (verb בּוֹא) and <WAH0413> (preposition אֶל) onto 進, per rule 6
方舟 (UNV) → 樓船 (LCC): different Chinese terms for Noah's ark; SN08392 transferred to 樓船
世代中 (UNV) → 世代 (LCC): locative 中 omitted in LCC; <WAH09002><WH01755> attached to 世代
只有 is LCC's interpretive addition (emphasizes exclusivity, 'only you'); has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated; object marker <WAH0853> attached to 你 following 只有
是個義人 (LCC) adds classifier 個 vs. UNV 是義人; SN06662 (צַדִּיק) attached to 義人 only, 個 left unannotated
